text:
Type: square glass-top coffee table with drawer
Use: holding drinks and books, displaying small items under the glass, storage; living room, family room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: white painted wood, clear glass top, metal knob
Colors: white, clear glass, dark grey knob
Shape: square top with an inset glass panel, shallow display drawer, open lower shelf, four tapered legs, molded edges, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, bright, homey, tidy
Goes with: white or cream sofas, grey and blue accents, light floors; classic, coastal or farmhouse living rooms

product.name: LIATORP
product.description: Practical storage space underneath the table top.
